title: WorldsgenUtils
description: Util plugin for worldsgen Including Item Mob and timed spawners!
body:
### This Plugin Was Originally Used for Worldsgen(Join at worldsgen.minehut.gg) and now is fully published on Modrinth. 
Command List

|Command     |Usage      | Deprecated(y/n) |
|:------------:|:-----------:|:--------------:|
|/itemgen    |Summons An Item|Yes|
|/mobgen     |Summons A Mob|Yes|
|/timespawner|Starts A Timed Spawner which can summon a specified item/mob for amount every {time} seconds|No, Will be Here for a long time|

### How Should You Use it?
Available On Papermc
[![Available On Paper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8efd49ac5e9e4c2f25aee5aaeb9cb08ad8ba0fae_0.webp)](https://papermc.io/)

<details>
<summary>Important!</summary>

every version name with the name like this:WorldsgenUtils-R-{version} is a Reworked Version! We Will Rework It In rd-1032170 and after

</details>


<details>
<summary>This is important for every version after R-1.0.0</summary>
I have been updating it, here are the following changes:
  item gen:
  
    /timespawner item <amount> <time in seconds>
    hold the item to spawn in your hand

  mob gen:
  
    Look at mob:
    
      /timespawner mob <amount> <seconds>
      
</details>
